output.review_comment: PR requires changes before merge: (1) Missing PR description - no confirmation that tests actually pass; (2) Logic concern - the comment states "cap always wins, even if it brings fee below minimum," but the code applies minimum AFTER cap, which could allow minimum to override cap if MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS > balance_cents//5. This contradicts the stated spec. Please clarify whether the min/cap ordering is correct and matches the agreed-upon finance spec; (3) Please confirm that all test cases pass, not just a subset. The reordering of min/cap constraints could indicate the changes were made to satisfy specific tests rather than implement the correct business logic.
